# Königsberger Bridges Institute (KBI)

> KBI builds communities of competent, curious, kind, and fun people. We organize emerging-technology olympiads, competency certifications, and conferences. KBI is a non-profit association (Königsberger Brückeninstitut MTÜ) founded in 2017 and based in Estonia.

Vision: prepare humanity for unknown unknowns through continuous innovation.
Mission: build communities of competent, curious, kind, and fun people, where we uplift each other and our society towards our vision.
Name: the institute takes its name from Euler's 1736 solution to the Königsberger Bridges Problem, a practical STEM answer to a real-world question.
We bridge: tech with design thinking; ambitions to actions; cultural and social divides; academia and industry.
Annual global impact: 10,000 global outreach, 4,000 participants, 700 tech projects, 50 countries and territories.

## Olympiads
- International Blockchain Olympiad (IBCOL), since 2017: https://2026.ibcol.org
- International Data Science Olympiad (IDSOL), since 2020: https://2026.idsol.org
- International Quantum Computing Olympiad (IQCOL), since 2026: https://2026.iqcol.org
- Overview: https://www.kb.institute/olympiads/

## Conferences (Emerging Technologies Olympiads, ETO)
- ETO Western Conference 2027: 16–17 October 2027, Oxford and Greater London Area, UK (hosted by KBI West)
- ETO Eastern Conference 2027: 28–29 October 2027, Hong Kong and Shenzhen (hosted by KBI East)
